pages.text: Faintly warm to the touch. That's probably fine.

pages.title: Where It Grows
pages.text: Uranium hides in small veins below y=30, in both the Overworld and the $(l:orespawn_integrations:dimensions/mining_dimension)Mining Dimension$(). Our cross-dimension veins also thread it beneath the Twilight Forest, for knights who prefer their treasure glowing.$(p)The veins run small by design: together with $(l:orespawn_integrations:ores_gems/titanium)Titanium$(), uranium forges Ultimate-tier gear — and that edge is meant to be earned.
